mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, create_time FROM `dizhi` WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY is_default DESC, id DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `dizhi` (user_id, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, is_default, create_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{isDefault}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE `dizhi` SET user_id = #{userId}, receiver_name = #{receiverName}, receiver_phone = #{receiverPhone}, receiver_address = #{receiverAddress}, is_default = #{isDefault}, create_time = #{createTime} WHERE id = #{id}
